_meta.notes: Country-scoped curated nodes; link via relationships during ingest.

nodes.name: Elamite Divine Kingship
nodes.label: Elamite Divine Kingship
nodes.definition: Ancient Elamite concept of the king as representative of the gods, particularly Inshushinak, legitimizing royal authority through divine mandate.

nodes.name: Zoroastrian Dualism
nodes.label: Zoroastrian Dualism
nodes.definition: The foundational Zoroastrian concept of cosmic struggle between Ahura Mazda (good) and Angra Mainyu (evil), influencing Persian worldview and ethics.

nodes.name: Asha (Cosmic Order)
nodes.label: Asha (Cosmic Order)
nodes.definition: Central Zoroastrian concept of truth, righteousness, and cosmic order that governs the universe and human morality.

nodes.name: Achaemenid Universal Empire
nodes.label: Achaemenid Universal Empire
nodes.definition: Persian imperial ideology under the Achaemenids claiming universal sovereignty as 'King of Kings' ruling over diverse peoples with divine sanction.

nodes.name: Persian Tolerance Policy
nodes.label: Persian Tolerance Policy
nodes.definition: Achaemenid policy of religious and cultural tolerance toward subject peoples, allowing local customs and religions while maintaining imperial unity.

nodes.name: Sasanian Xwarra (Divine Glory)
nodes.label: Sasanian Xwarra
nodes.definition: Concept of royal divine glory or fortune bestowed by Ahura Mazda upon legitimate kings, central to Sasanian royal ideology.

nodes.name: Persian Islamic Synthesis
nodes.label: Persian Islamic Synthesis
nodes.definition: The blending of pre-Islamic Persian culture, philosophy, and administration with Islamic religion and Arabic learning creating a distinctive civilization.

nodes.name: Shia Imamate Doctrine
nodes.label: Shia Imamate Doctrine
nodes.definition: Belief in divinely appointed Imams from Ali's lineage as rightful leaders of the Muslim community, central to Iranian Shia identity.

nodes.name: Persian Sufi Love Mysticism
nodes.label: Persian Sufi Love Mysticism
nodes.definition: Mystical tradition expressing divine love through poetry and spiritual practice, exemplified by Rumi and Hafez, shaping Persian literature.

nodes.name: Safavid Shia State Religion
nodes.label: Safavid Shia State Religion
nodes.definition: Establishment of Twelver Shia Islam as Iran's official religion under the Safavids, creating lasting religious national identity.

nodes.name: Persian Miniature Aesthetics
nodes.label: Persian Miniature Aesthetics
nodes.definition: Artistic principles of Persian manuscript illumination emphasizing vivid colors, elaborate detail, and integration of text and image.

nodes.name: Isfahan Urban Planning
nodes.label: Isfahan Urban Planning
nodes.definition: Safavid concepts of ideal city design centered on Naqsh-e Jahan Square, integrating religious, commercial, and royal spaces.

nodes.name: Qajar Modernization Reforms
nodes.label: Qajar Modernization Reforms
nodes.definition: 19th century efforts to adopt Western technology, education, and institutions while preserving Iranian sovereignty and identity.

nodes.name: Iranian Constitutional Movement
nodes.label: Iranian Constitutional Movement
nodes.definition: Early 20th century movement demanding constitutional limits on royal power, leading to the 1906 Persian Constitutional Revolution.

nodes.name: Pahlavi Nationalism
nodes.label: Pahlavi Nationalism
nodes.definition: State ideology under the Pahlavis emphasizing pre-Islamic Persian heritage, modernization, and centralized national identity.

nodes.name: Velayat-e Faqih (Guardianship of the Jurist)
nodes.label: Velayat-e Faqih
nodes.definition: Ayatollah Khomeini's theory of Islamic governance where a qualified jurist exercises political authority during the Imam's occultation.

nodes.name: Islamic Republic Ideology
nodes.label: Islamic Republic Ideology
nodes.definition: Post-1979 political framework combining Islamic law, republican institutions, and revolutionary principles in Iranian governance.

nodes.name: Iranian Cultural Resistance
nodes.label: Iranian Cultural Resistance
nodes.definition: Contemporary strategies of preserving and expressing Persian cultural identity through art, literature, and social practices.
